title: Board Proximity Connect
description: Implement proximity connect: when dragging a node with no incident edges, overlapping another node's bounds shows a wire between nearest compatible handles (normal/detail/micro LOD only); release commits edge. Disabled in minimap and overview LOD.
summary: Node-drag proximity connect was missing: only link-drag pointer-up could emit proximityConnect. BoardHost now tracks proximity_pair on DragNodes (normal/detail/micro LOD, single unconnected node): overlapping node bounds pick the nearest compatible free handle pair via handles_link_compatible_for_drag in either direction (same rule engine as indirect/link), preview rubber wire during drag, commit proximityConnect on pointer-up. Tests: board_host_node_drag_proximity_connect_overlapping_compatible_handles, board_host_node_drag_skips_proximity_when_moving_node_has_incident_edge. cargo test -p elements_board --lib: 78 passed; vitest @elements/board: 75 passed; wasm pkg rebuilt.
